card.name: Linking words in cholestatic liver drug labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, for, and, the) and parts of the drug names LIVMARLI and BYLVAY, in labels for cholestatic liver conditions such as Alagille syndrome (ALGS) and PFIC.

modes.label: Linking words before liver terms
modes.description: A small word such as of, to, for, and, or the sits just before a liver-condition or anatomy term.

card.writes: It promotes long runs of spaces, dashes, asterisks and similar filler characters, and suppresses runs of spaces and tabs; this suggests table-like formatting rather than a content effect.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and brand-name pieces in labels for bile-flow liver drugs like LIVMARLI and BYLVAY.
